title: 45,000-year-old crystal tool reveals Neanderthals valued beauty too
summary_full: A remarkable find in France reveals a 45,000-year-old Neanderthal quartz scraper that changes the narrative around these ancient beings. This tool, crafted from rare rock crystal, highlights that Neanderthals had an appreciation for aesthetics and craftsmanship, challenging the notion of them as mere primitive beings. The sophistication in its creation suggests a deeper cultural understanding and skillful manipulation of their environment, offering insights into Neanderthal life and artistry.
